tagline: Natural Mint Flavor for Global Blends
overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures dehydrated mint leaf powder from fresh mint leaves sourced in India. We clean, dry, and grind the leaves to an 80 to 100 mesh specification. Our dehydration process preserves the authentic cooling aroma and natural green color. As an FSSAI-registered manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter, we deliver consistent quality for large formulations.

Our dehydrated mint leaf powder has a moisture level under 7 percent and a shelf life of 24 months. We provide reliable bulk supply, OEM solutions, and private label services. Supported by a disciplined six-step production process and full export documentation, our facility supplies food manufacturers seeking stable, ready-to-use herbal ingredients.
highlights: Dehydrated to preserve natural green color and cooling aroma
Processed to a uniform 80-100 mesh size
Moisture content controlled at or below 7%
Manufactured from carefully sourced Indian mint leaves
Uniform flavor delivery across production batches

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for mint leaf powder?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity starts at 5 kg, supporting both pilot production runs and full commercial bulk shipments.

faqs.q: What is the shelf life and recommended storage for this product?
faqs.a: The powder has a shelf life of 24 months when stored in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture.

faqs.q: Do you provide custom mesh sizing or private label packaging?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer custom mesh adjustments, OEM supply, and private-label packaging options in pouches or jars on request.

faqs.q: Can prospective buyers request product samples?
faqs.a: Yes, product samples are available upon request to allow technical teams to evaluate quality and formulation suitability.

faqs.q: What manufacturing process is used to produce the powder?
faqs.a: We operate a 6-step method consisting of sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and dispatch packing.

faqs.q: Do you offer export documentation support for international shipments?
faqs.a: Yes. As an IEC-registered exporter, TradeNest Naturals provides comprehensive export documentation support for seamless logistics and clearance.
